$comment: OpenSetlist dev seed — 2 placeholder songs (lorem ipsum) for testing the P2 pages. Structure follows the drafted MVP schema: songs -> arrangements -> sections[{label, kind, content}]. Each section's content is ABC 2.1 (abcjs-parseable): chord symbols as quoted annotations, lyrics on w: lines aligned 1 syllable per note. Chord annotations are simplified placeholder harmonizations, not authoritative. Import via POST /api/songs/import (song-level fields only; arrangements/tags are skipped until #9/#20). Real songs for the alpha land with issue #17.
